verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions from the merchant's data inside PayPal's own product. What it documents is the MCP server, which lets merchants use natural language from external MCP clients to complete business tasks, and the agent toolkit, which gives developers building blocks. Neither is an in-product insights feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
